items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for new public launches, monetization expansion, affiliate or advertising changes, account setup, telemetry expansion, and security-sensitive releases. Conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only with 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; revenue is limited to one 2026-09-21 Amazon window with $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission. Exact decision: retain containment-only execution and keep all private or parked launch gates closed. Next evidence action: complete the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close record by 2026-09-30T07:30Z, then reassess capacity and launch evidence.

SearchWoot launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Current progress: official Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics, but not public or commercial rights; repository/configuration evidence is partial for data flow; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts exist, but deployed consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, deletion/correction/access workflow, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention capture, log/vendor/incident inventory, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

SearchWoot data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because written permission or an API agreement and field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising are missing. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, and request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next actions: prepare the internal rights counsel packet; produce the read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration without enabling new tracking; and produce the read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Required dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence is not attached. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet for each property containing those exact fields.

Compliance and data-quality review: incomplete telemetry is not by itself a blocker to ordinary reversible growth. Do not treat GA4/GSC errors as zero; repair source permissions or collector errors when the existing workstream permits. Preserve Amazon's $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed and do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Affiliate disclosures, claims, source provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries must remain unchanged unless separately evidenced and reviewed.
